+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const int entry = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int total = localTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const int localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = entry - localI * numTriangles;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[i];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[j];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

+ * This is a hybrid MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA implementation of room impulse response
+ * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation.  MPI partitions receiver
+ * rows, OpenMP accelerates the irregular octree visibility work, and CUDA runs
+ * the dense delay, wave-propagation, and correlation phases.  It models how

+inline val_t sampleUniform(uint64_t counter) {

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const int entry = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int total = localTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const int localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = entry - localI * numTriangles;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[i];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[j];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const int entry = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int total = localTriangles * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const int localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = entry - localI * numTriangles;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[i];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[j];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}
+

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA and MPI Runtime Support

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));

+    std::abort();
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};

+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};

+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;

+}

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};

+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};

+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};

+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;

+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}

     1	/**
     2	 * Room Response Simulation Benchmark
     3	 * 
     4	 * This is a hybrid MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA implementation of room impulse response
     5	 * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation.  MPI partitions receiver
     6	 * rows, OpenMP accelerates the irregular octree visibility work, and CUDA runs
     7	 * the dense delay, wave-propagation, and correlation phases.  It models how
     8	 * sound/light waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:
     9	 * 
    10	 * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry
    11	 * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)
    12	 * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values
    13	 *

   390	            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);
   391	        }

   395	// ============================================================================
   396	// Stateless Sampling
   397	// ============================================================================
   398	
   399	// Form-factor samples are indexed by (receiver, emitter, ray, coordinate), so
   400	// the same samples are generated regardless of MPI partitioning or OpenMP
   401	// scheduling.  This preserves the original uniform Monte-Carlo estimator while
   402	// making every matrix entry independently computable.
   403	inline val_t sampleUniform(uint64_t counter) {
   404	    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   405	    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   406	    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
   407	    counter ^= counter >> 31;
   408	    return static_cast<val_t>(counter >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
   409	}
   410	
   411	// Generate a uniformly sampled point inside a triangle from two deterministic
   412	// random values.
   413	Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {
   414	    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
   415	        u = 1.0f - u;
   416	        v = 1.0f - v;
   417	    }
   418	    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;
   419	    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;
   420	    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;
   421	}
   422	
   423	// ============================================================================
   424	// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)
   425	// ============================================================================
   426	
   427	val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
   428	                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
   429	    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
   430	    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
   431	    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
   432	    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
   433	
   434	    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   435	
   436	    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
   437	    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
   438	    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
   439	    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   440	
   441	    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
   442	    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
   443	    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   444	
   445	    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
   446	}

   448	// ============================================================================
   449	// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)
   450	// ============================================================================
   451	
   452	// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle
   453	// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search
   454	bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
   455	                  const Octree& octree,
   456	                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {
   457	    Vec3 dir = to - from;
   458	    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();
   459	    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;
   460	    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;
   461	
   462	    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {
   463	        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;
   464	
   465	        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);
   466	        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {
   467	            return true;  // Ray is blocked
   468	        }
   469	        return false;
   470	    });
   471	}
   472	
   473	// ============================================================================
   474	// Form Factor Computation (Kij)
   475	// ============================================================================
   476	
   477	// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal
   478	val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {
   479	    val_t vNorm = v.norm();
   480	    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
   481	    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);
   482	}
   483	
   484	// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)
   485	val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,
   486	                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,
   487	                  const Octree& octree) {
   488	    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];
   489	    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];
   490	
   491	    // Cull triangles facing the same direction
   492	    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
   493	
   494	    val_t kij = ZERO;
   495	
   496	    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {
   497	        const uint64_t sampleBase =
   498	            ((static_cast<uint64_t>(idxI) * triangles.size() + idxJ) * NUM_RAYS + r) * 4ULL;
   499	        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, sampleUniform(sampleBase),
   500	                                        sampleUniform(sampleBase + 1));
   501	        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, sampleUniform(sampleBase + 2),
   502	                                        sampleUniform(sampleBase + 3));
   503	
   504	        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;
   505	
   506	        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
   507	        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();
   508	        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;
   509	
   510	        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());
   511	        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());
   512	
   513	        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
   514	
   515	        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);
   520	
   521	// ============================================================================
   522	// Tau (time delay) Computation
   523	// ============================================================================
   524	
   525	int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {
   526	    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();
   527	    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   528	}

   534	[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
   535	                              const char* file, int line) {
   536	    int rank = -1;
   537	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   538	    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
   539	            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
   540	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
   541	    std::abort();
   542	}

   546	    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
   547	} while (false)

   549	template <typename T>
   550	class PinnedBuffer {
   551	public:
   552	    PinnedBuffer() = default;
   553	    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
   554	    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
   555	    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
   556	
   557	    ~PinnedBuffer() {
   558	        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
   559	    }
   560	
   561	    void resize(size_t count) {
   562	        if (data_ != nullptr) {
   563	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
   564	            data_ = nullptr;
   565	            size_ = 0;
   566	        }
   567	        if (count != 0) {
   568	            void* raw = nullptr;
   569	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
   570	            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
   571	            size_ = count;
   572	            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
   573	        }
   574	    }
   575	
   576	    T* data() { return data_; }
   577	    const T* data() const { return data_; }
   578	    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
   579	    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
   580	    size_t size() const { return size_; }
   581	
   582	private:
   583	    T* data_ = nullptr;
   584	    size_t size_ = 0;
   585	};

   587	struct DeviceTriangle {
   588	    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
   589	};

   591	constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
   592	
   593	__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
   594	                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
   595	    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   596	    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
   597	    if (entry >= total) return;
   598	
   599	    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
   600	    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
   601	    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
   602	    if (i == j) {
   603	        tau[entry] = 0;
   604	        return;
   605	    }
   606	
   607	    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
   608	    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
   609	    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
   610	    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
   611	    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
   612	    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   613	}
   614	
   615	__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
   616	                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
   617	                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
   618	                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
   619	                                val_t reflectivity) {
   620	    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
   621	    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
   622	
   623	    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
   624	    val_t partial = ZERO;
   625	    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
   626	    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
   627	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
   628	        if (i == j) continue;
   629	        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
   630	        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
   631	
   632	        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
   633	        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
   634	
   635	        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
   636	            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
   637	        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
   638	        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
   639	    }
   640	
   641	    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
   642	    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
   643	    __syncthreads();
   644	    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
   645	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
   646	        __syncthreads();
   647	    }
   648	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   649	        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
   650	        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
   651	    }
   652	}
   653	
   654	__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
   655	                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
   656	                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
   657	    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
   658	    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
   659	
   660	    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
   661	    int bestTime = 0;
   662	    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
   663	    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
   664	        val_t correlation = ZERO;
   665	        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
   666	            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
   667	                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
   668	        }
   669	        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
   670	            bestCorrelation = correlation;
   671	            bestTime = lag;
   672	        }
   673	    }
   674	
   675	    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
   676	    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
   677	    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
   678	    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
   679	    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
   680	    __syncthreads();
   681	    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
   682	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
   683	            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
   684	            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
   685	            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
   686	                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
   687	                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
   688	                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
   689	            }
   690	        }
   691	        __syncthreads();
   692	    }
   693	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
   694	}

   700	struct SimulationState {
   701	    size_t numTriangles;
   702	    size_t numTimesteps;
   703	    size_t firstTriangle;
   704	    size_t localTriangles;
   705	    int mpiRank;
   706	    int mpiSize;
   707	
   708	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   709	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   710	    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
   711	    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Locally owned Kij rows (localN x N)
   712	    std::vector<int> tau;           // Locally owned Tau rows (localN x N)
   713	    PinnedBuffer<val_t> radB;       // Globally replicated B history (T x N)
   714	    std::vector<val_t> localDistances;
   715	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Root-only globally ordered result
   716	    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
   717	    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
   718	
   719	    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure
   720	
   721	    size_t sourceIndex;
   722	
   723	    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
   724	};
