   726	// ============================================================================
   727	// Initialization
   728	// ============================================================================
   729	
   730	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   731	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity,
   732	                          int mpiRank, int mpiSize) {
   733	    // Generate mesh
   734	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
   735	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   736	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   737	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   738	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   739	    state.mpiRank = mpiRank;
   740	    state.mpiSize = mpiSize;
   741	
   742	    const size_t baseRows = state.numTriangles / static_cast<size_t>(mpiSize);
   743	    const size_t remainder = state.numTriangles % static_cast<size_t>(mpiSize);
   744	    state.localTriangles = baseRows + (static_cast<size_t>(mpiRank) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
   745	    state.firstTriangle = static_cast<size_t>(mpiRank) * baseRows +
   746	                          std::min(static_cast<size_t>(mpiRank), remainder);
   747	    state.rowCounts.resize(mpiSize);
   748	    state.rowDisplacements.resize(mpiSize);
   749	    int displacement = 0;
   750	    for (int rank = 0; rank < mpiSize; ++rank) {
   751	        const size_t rows = baseRows + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
   752	        state.rowCounts[rank] = static_cast<int>(rows);
   753	        state.rowDisplacements[rank] = displacement;
   754	        displacement += state.rowCounts[rank];
   755	    }
   756	
   757	    if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   758	
   759	    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
   760	    if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Building octree...\n");
   761	    state.octree.build(state.triangles);
   762	
   763	    // Initialize areas
   764	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   765	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   766	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(state.numTriangles); ++i) {
   767	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   768	    }
   769	
   770	    // Initialize reflectivity
   771	    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);
   772	
   773	    // Initialize matrices
   774	    const size_t localEntries = state.localTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   775	    state.kij.resize(localEntries, ZERO);
   776	    state.tau.resize(localEntries, 0);
   777	    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles);
   778	    state.localDistances.resize(state.localTriangles, ZERO);
   779	}
   780	
   781	// ============================================================================
   782	// Precomputation Phase
   783	// ============================================================================
   784	
   785	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   786	    // Each rank computes a disjoint, contiguous range of receiver rows.  The
   787	    // stateless sample generator makes this decomposition bitwise repeatable
   788	    // for a fixed rank count and independent of OpenMP scheduling.
   789	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)
   790	    for (long long localI = 0; localI < static_cast<long long>(state.localTriangles); ++localI) {
   791	        const size_t i = state.firstTriangle + static_cast<size_t>(localI);
   792	        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
   793	            if (i == j) continue;
   794	            state.kij[static_cast<size_t>(localI) * state.numTriangles + j] =
   795	                computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree);
   796	        }
   797	    }
   798	}
   799	
   800	class CudaExecutor {
   801	public:
   802	    explicit CudaExecutor(const SimulationState& state) {
   803	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   804	        allocate(triangles_, state.numTriangles);
   805	        allocate(areas_, state.numTriangles);
   806	        allocate(kij_, state.kij.size());
   807	        allocate(tau_, state.tau.size());
   808	        allocate(radB_, state.radB.size());
   809	        allocate(localCurrent_, state.localTriangles);
   810	        allocate(localDistances_, state.localTriangles);
   811	
   812	        std::vector<DeviceTriangle> deviceTriangles(state.numTriangles);
   813	        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   814	            const Vec3 center = state.triangles[i].center();
   815	            deviceTriangles[i] = {center.x, center.y, center.z};
   816	        }
   817	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(triangles_, deviceTriangles.data(),
   818	                                   state.numTriangles * sizeof(DeviceTriangle),
   819	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   820	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(areas_, state.areas.data(),
   821	                                   state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
   822	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   823	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(radB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t), stream_));
   824	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   825	    }
   826	
   827	    CudaExecutor(const CudaExecutor&) = delete;
   828	    CudaExecutor& operator=(const CudaExecutor&) = delete;
   829	
   830	    ~CudaExecutor() {
   831	        if (stream_ != nullptr) cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_);
   832	        if (triangles_ != nullptr) cudaFree(triangles_);
   833	        if (areas_ != nullptr) cudaFree(areas_);
   834	        if (kij_ != nullptr) cudaFree(kij_);
   835	        if (tau_ != nullptr) cudaFree(tau_);
   836	        if (radB_ != nullptr) cudaFree(radB_);
   837	        if (localCurrent_ != nullptr) cudaFree(localCurrent_);
   838	        if (localDistances_ != nullptr) cudaFree(localDistances_);
   839	        if (stream_ != nullptr) cudaStreamDestroy(stream_);
   840	    }
   841	
   842	    void launchTimeDelays(const SimulationState& state) {
   843	        const size_t entries = state.localTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   844	        if (entries == 0) return;
   845	        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
   846	            (entries + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS);
   847	        computeTauKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_THREADS, 0, stream_>>>(
   848	            triangles_, tau_, static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles),
   849	            static_cast<int>(state.firstTriangle), static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles));
   850	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   851	    }
   852	
   853	    void finishTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
   854	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.tau.data(), tau_, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int),
   855	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
   856	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   857	    }
   858	
   859	    void uploadFormFactors(const SimulationState& state) {
   860	        if (!state.kij.empty()) {
   861	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(kij_, state.kij.data(), state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t),
   862	                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   863	        }
   864	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   865	    }
   866	
   867	    void runSimulation(SimulationState& state, bool retainHostHistory) {
   868	        PinnedBuffer<val_t> localRow(state.localTriangles);
   869	        PinnedBuffer<val_t> globalRow(state.numTriangles);
   870	        const int emissionEnd = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps / 2);
   871	        for (size_t time = 0; time < state.numTimesteps; ++time) {
   872	            if (state.localTriangles != 0) {
   873	                propagateKernel<<<static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles), CUDA_THREADS,
   874	                                  CUDA_THREADS * sizeof(val_t), stream_>>>(
   875	                    kij_, tau_, areas_, radB_, localCurrent_, static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles),
   876	                    static_cast<int>(state.firstTriangle), static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles),
   877	                    static_cast<int>(time), static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), emissionEnd,
   878	                    state.rho[0]);
   879	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   880	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(localRow.data(), localCurrent_,
   881	                                           state.localTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
   882	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
   883	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   884	            }
   885	
   886	            MPI_Allgatherv(localRow.data(), static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles), MPI_FLOAT,
   887	                           globalRow.data(), state.rowCounts.data(), state.rowDisplacements.data(),
   888	                           MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   889	            if (retainHostHistory) {
   890	                std::memcpy(state.radB.data() + time * state.numTriangles, globalRow.data(),
   891	                            state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t));
   892	            }
   893	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(radB_ + time * state.numTriangles, globalRow.data(),
   894	                                       state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
   895	                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   896	
   897	            if (state.mpiRank == 0 && ((time + 1) % 10 == 0 || time + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {
   898	                printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", time + 1, state.numTimesteps);
   899	            }
   900	        }
   901	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   902	    }
   903	
   904	    void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
   905	        if (state.localTriangles != 0) {
   906	            constexpr int distanceThreads = 256;
   907	            const size_t sharedBytes = distanceThreads * (sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(int));
   908	            distanceKernel<<<static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles), distanceThreads, sharedBytes, stream_>>>(
   909	                radB_, localDistances_, static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles),
   910	                static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps), static_cast<int>(state.firstTriangle),
   911	                static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles), static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex));
   912	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   913	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.localDistances.data(), localDistances_,
   914	                                       state.localTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
   915	                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
   916	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   917	        }
   918	
   919	        if (state.mpiRank == 0) state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles);
   920	        MPI_Gatherv(state.localDistances.data(), static_cast<int>(state.localTriangles), MPI_FLOAT,
   921	                    state.mpiRank == 0 ? state.distances.data() : nullptr,
   922	                    state.rowCounts.data(), state.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT,
   923	                    0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   924	    }
   925	
   926	private:
   927	    template <typename T>
   928	    void allocate(T*& pointer, size_t count) {
   929	        void* raw = nullptr;
   930	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&raw, std::max<size_t>(count, 1) * sizeof(T)));
  1048	// ============================================================================

  1050	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
  1051	    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
  1052	    printf("Options:\n");
  1053	    printf("  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\n");
  1054	    printf("               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\n");
  1055	    printf("               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480, 81920\n");
  1056	    printf("  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\n");
  1057	    printf("  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\n");
  1058	    printf("  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\n");
  1059	    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
  1060	    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
  1061	    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
  1062	}
  1063	
  1064	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  1065	    int providedThreadLevel = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
  1066	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &providedThreadLevel);
  1067	    if (providedThreadLevel < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
  1068	        fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED support\n");
  1069	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
  1070	        return 1;
  1071	    }
  1072	
  1073	    int mpiRank = 0;
  1074	    int mpiSize = 1;
  1075	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiRank);
  1076	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiSize);
  1077	
  1078	    int targetTriangles = 320;
  1079	    int timesteps = 50;
  1080	    int sourceIdx = 0;
  1081	    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;
  1082	    bool validate = false;
  1083	    bool printResults = false;
  1084	    bool showHelp = false;
  1085	    bool parseError = false;
  1086	
  1087	    // Parse command line arguments
  1088	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
  1089	        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
  1090	            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);
  1091	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
  1092	            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
  1093	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
  1094	            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);
  1095	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
  1096	            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));
  1097	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
  1098	            validate = true;
  1099	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0) {
  1100	            printResults = true;
  1101	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
  1102	            showHelp = true;
  1103	        } else {
  1104	            if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
  1105	            parseError = true;
  1106	        }
  1107	    }
  1108	
  1109	    if (showHelp || parseError || timesteps <= 0 || targetTriangles <= 0) {
  1110	        if (mpiRank == 0) {
  1111	            if (timesteps <= 0 || targetTriangles <= 0) {
  1112	                printf("Triangle count and timestep count must both be positive.\n");
  1113	            }
  1114	            printUsage(argv[0]);
  1115	        }
  1116	        MPI_Finalize();
  1117	        return parseError || timesteps <= 0 || targetTriangles <= 0 ? 1 : 0;
  1118	    }
  1119	
  1120	    // One rank uses one accelerator when possible.  Multiple local ranks round
  1121	    // robin over the node's visible GPUs, which also supports scheduler-provided
  1122	    // CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES masks without any program options.
  1123	    int deviceCount = 0;
  1124	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
  1125	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
  1126	        if (mpiRank == 0) fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA accelerator is visible to this MPI job.\n");
  1127	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
  1128	        return 1;
  1129	    }
  1130	    MPI_Comm localComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
  1131	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, mpiRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);
  1132	    int localRank = 0;
  1133	    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);
  1134	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));
  1135	    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);
  1136	
  1137	    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);
  1138	
  1139	    int exitCode = 0;
  1140	    {
  1141	        if (mpiRank == 0) {
  1142	            printf("Room Response Simulation Benchmark\n");
  1143	            printf("===================================\n");
  1144	            printf("Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\n", targetTriangles, subdivisions);
  1145	            printf("Timesteps: %d\n", timesteps);
  1146	            printf("Source triangle: %d\n", sourceIdx);
  1147	            printf("Reflectivity: %.2f\n", reflectivity);
  1148	            printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
  1149	            printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI ranks, %d OpenMP threads/rank, CUDA device %d on rank 0\n\n",
  1150	                   mpiSize, omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount == 0 ? -1 : 0);
  1151	        }
  1152	
  1153	        SimulationState state;
  1154	        initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),
  1155	                             static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity, mpiRank, mpiSize);
  1156	        CudaExecutor cuda(state);
  1157	
  1158	        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1159	        const auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1160	        if (mpiRank == 0) printf("\nComputing time delays (Tau) and form factors (Kij)...\n");
  1161	        cuda.launchTimeDelays(state);
  1162	        computeFormFactors(state);
  1163	        cuda.finishTimeDelays(state);
  1164	        cuda.uploadFormFactors(state);
  1165	        const auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1166	        const long long localPreDuration =
  1167	            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();
  1168	        long long preDuration = 0;
  1169	        MPI_Reduce(&localPreDuration, &preDuration, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1170	        if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Precomputation time (slowest rank): %lld ms\n\n", preDuration);
  1171	
  1172	        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1173	        const auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1174	        if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");
  1175	        cuda.runSimulation(state, validate);
  1176	        const auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1177	        const long long localSimDuration =
  1178	            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();
  1179	        long long simDuration = 0;
  1180	        MPI_Reduce(&localSimDuration, &simDuration, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1181	        if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Simulation time (slowest rank): %lld ms\n\n", simDuration);
  1182	
  1183	        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1184	        const auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1185	        if (mpiRank == 0) printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");
  1186	        cuda.computeDistances(state);
  1187	        const auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  1188	        const long long localDistDuration =
  1189	            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();
  1190	        long long distDuration = 0;
  1191	        MPI_Reduce(&localDistDuration, &distDuration, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1192	
  1193	        if (mpiRank == 0) {
  1194	            printf("Distance computation time (slowest rank): %lld ms\n\n", distDuration);
  1195	            const long long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;
  1196	            const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
  1197	            const size_t t = state.numTimesteps;
  1198	            const double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n) * n;
  1199	            const double simOps = static_cast<double>(n) * n * t;
  1200	            const double distOps = static_cast<double>(n) * t * t;
  1201	            const size_t localMatrixBytes = state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t) +
  1202	                                            state.tau.size() * sizeof(int);
  1203	            printf("Total computation time: %lld ms\n", totalTime);
  1204	            printf("\nPerformance:\n");
  1205	            printf("  Triangles: %zu\n", n);
  1206	            printf("  Timesteps: %zu\n", t);
  1207	            printf("  Form factor computations: %.2e\n", kijOps);
  1208	            printf("  Simulation operations: %.2e\n", simOps);
  1209	            printf("  Distance computations: %.2e\n", distOps);
  1210	            printf("  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\n", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);
  1211	            printf("  Rank-0 distributed matrix storage: %.2f MB\n",
  1212	                   localMatrixBytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
  1213	            printf("  Result hash: %016lX\n\n", computeHash(state));
  1214	
  1215	            if (printResults) {
  1216	                std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());
  1217	                print_results(distData, "Distances");
  1218	            }
  1219	        }
  1220	
  1221	        if (validate && !validateResults(state)) exitCode = 1;
  1222	    }
  1223	
  1224	    MPI_Finalize();
  1225	    return exitCode;
  1226	}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}
+

+// CUDA and MPI Runtime Support

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t status, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d: CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(status));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) do { \
+    const cudaError_t cudaStatus = (expression); \
+    if (cudaStatus != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(cudaStatus, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
+} while (false)
+
+template <typename T>
+class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    PinnedBuffer() = default;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) { resize(count); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    ~PinnedBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(data_);
+    }
+
+    void resize(size_t count) {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(data_));
+            data_ = nullptr;
+            size_ = 0;
+        }
+        if (count != 0) {
+            void* raw = nullptr;
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&raw, count * sizeof(T)));
+            data_ = static_cast<T*>(raw);
+            size_ = count;
+            std::fill(data_, data_ + size_, T{});
+        }
+    }
+
+    T* data() { return data_; }
+    const T* data() const { return data_; }
+    T& operator[](size_t index) { return data_[index]; }
+    const T& operator[](size_t index) const { return data_[index]; }
+    size_t size() const { return size_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t size_ = 0;
+};

+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    val_t centerX, centerY, centerZ;
+};
+
+constexpr int CUDA_THREADS = 256;
+
+__global__ void computeTauKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                 int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles) {
+    const size_t entry = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (entry >= total) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = entry / numTriangles;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(entry - localI * numTriangles);
+    const int i = firstTriangle + static_cast<int>(localI);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[entry] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const DeviceTriangle receiver = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+    const DeviceTriangle emitter = triangles[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
+    const val_t dx = receiver.centerX - emitter.centerX;
+    const val_t dy = receiver.centerY - emitter.centerY;
+    const val_t dz = receiver.centerZ - emitter.centerZ;
+    tau[entry] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                const val_t* radB, val_t* localCurrent,
+                                int numTriangles, int firstTriangle, int localTriangles,
+                                int timestep, int sourceIndex, int emissionEnd,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const val_t* kijRow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    const int* tauRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(localI) * numTriangles;
+    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int tauij = tauRow[j];
+        if (timestep < tauij) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kijRow[j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep - tauij) * numTriangles + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+        partial += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t partialSums[];
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < emissionEnd) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        localCurrent[localI] = reflectivity * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                               int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,
+                               int firstTriangle, int localTriangles, int sourceIndex) {
+    const int localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localTriangles) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    const int i = firstTriangle + localI;
+    for (int lag = threadIdx.x; lag < numTimesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (int time = lag; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + i] *
+                           radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = lag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    extern __shared__ unsigned char sharedMemory[];
+    val_t* correlations = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(sharedMemory);
+    int* times = reinterpret_cast<int*>(correlations + blockDim.x);
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = bestCorrelation;
+    times[threadIdx.x] = bestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int otherTime = times[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (otherCorrelation > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (otherCorrelation == correlations[threadIdx.x] && otherTime < times[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = otherCorrelation;
+                times[threadIdx.x] = otherTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(times[0]);
+}
+
